instructions: VIctory for macOS runs Xbox Series applications on Apple Silicon Macs through Wine, Rosetta 2 and D3DMetal. The code is Rust: a PE loader, HLE of the console runtime, a shader translator (console GPU ISA to DXIL) and a D3D12 GPU layer. Review for correctness first: wrong GPU state, data races in lock-free code, unsound unsafe blocks, x86 instruction encoding, and changes that silently drop work (draws, views, copies) or alias stale data. Performance claims should come with numbers from matched runs.
